response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(CASE WHEN type IN ('PRIJEM','VYDAJ') THEN amount END) AS avg_amount, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM trans GROUP BY account_id) SELECT account_id, avg_amount, txn_count, txn_count * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(txn_count) FROM per) AS ratio FROM per ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The average amount covers only PRIJEM (credit) and VYDAJ (withdrawal) rows, taken literally from 'credits and withdrawals'. The undocumented VYBER rows are excluded from the average. Amounts are unsigned, so they are averaged as stored.
The transaction count includes every transaction of the account, including VYBER rows. The overall average per account is total transactions divided by the number of accounts in trans.

alternatives.interpretation: 'Credits and withdrawals' just means all transactions, so VYBER rows are included in the average amount too.
alternatives.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM trans GROUP BY account_id) SELECT account_id, avg_amount, txn_count, txn_count * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(txn_count) FROM per) AS ratio FROM per ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10;
